summary: 5E Advanced Materials filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary 5E SVM was selected as the successful bidder for specified assets of Searles Valley Minerals Inc. and affiliates in a Section 363 bankruptcy sale, with an Asset Purchase Agreement signed September 14, 2026. Consideration comprises ~$3.4 million cash (less a $300,000 earnest money deposit), 8.3 million unregistered 5E common shares, and a ~$6.2 million senior unsecured promissory note issued by 5E SVM for seller lenders. Closing requires U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware approval, subject to objection, appeal, or stay. Watch court milestones, overhang from resale registration, and any competing or revised bids.
